tasks.short: Prepare financial reports for the book.

steps.what: Prepare financial reports from those balances.
Check the report against the source figures.

tasks.design: Client and corporate balances are pulled from the {ERP} into a {BI} report. The agent checks the tables against those balances and signs the version. The signed report is filed in {DOCS}. A figure that does not match a balance is left off the report.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report was copied from the ledger into a side file, so a late entry was easy to miss.
tasks.enabler_now: A financial report of this kind is the balances, arranged. The check against the source is the remaining work.
tasks.still_hard: What the report should say about a loss is commentary, and the agent still writes that sentence.
tasks.human_edge: The agent signs the report and writes any sentence that is not a balance. The table does not explain the book.

ambition.what: Sign the financial report every week it is due, including quiet weeks that used to be skipped.

tasks.altitude: Copying balances leaves the hour. The agent still signs and still writes the commentary.

reach.task: prepare a monthly pipeline report from the offer records
reach.learn: which total must equal the source rows before the report is filed

evidence.claim: The job digest treats financial reports of positions and results as dashboards. Commentary stays with the person.
Filing a client report is a record. It does not score the agent, and seller scoring would need works-council consent.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is the report. Trading and the blotter break are other tasks.

Fields: account, balance, as-of date, currency. Balances come from the {ERP}. A figure with no balance id is excluded. Commentary is typed by the agent. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The ledger already holds the balances. The build arranges them and files a signed version. It does not add a second ledger.
The signature covers that version. A balance change voids it.
unknowns: Whether the report goes to a client, the house, or both.
research_questions: What share of the report is commentary rather than balances?
How often does a balance change after the extract?

already_counted.description: The agent still checks and signs the report.

incremental.description: Keep the balance map and the report headings current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the ledger is late and the agent still rebuilds the tables, the saving is only the weeks when the extract matches.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Supply the latest price quotes for the name.
Attach the issuer's filed financial positions.
Check a quote the terminal marks stale.
Send the quote pack the agent approved.

tasks.design: The latest price quotes come from the market terminal ({OTHER}). A short issuer note is attached only from filed positions in {DOCS}. The agent checks a quote the terminal marks stale and approves the pack. Only that version is sent. A stale quote with no check is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Quotes were read aloud from a screen the other person could not see, and an old price travelled with them.
tasks.enabler_now: A quote is a feed with a time. Sending the latest row, and holding a stale one, is a rule.
tasks.still_hard: What the quote means for this client is advice, and this pack must not say it.
tasks.human_edge: The agent decides whether a stale quote can still be sent, and does not add a recommendation.

ambition.what: Supply a checked quote on small names the same hour it is asked, not only on names the agent already watches.

tasks.altitude: Reading the quote aloud leaves the task. The agent still holds a stale quote and still refuses to add advice.

reach.task: supply a published fare with its time stamp
reach.learn: which stale price must be held back

evidence.claim: Supplying a quote from a terminal is a feed plus a record of the issuer. The job digest leaves advice with the person.
The job digest says securities advice stays with the person, and advising staff need a diploma. A draft is not the advice. The pack is not a machine caller. It is a message the agent approved.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task supplies quotes and filed issuer information. A recommendation is the advice task.

Fields: instrument id, price, as-of time, issuer id, filing date. The price comes from the market terminal. Issuer text comes from {DOCS}. A quote older than the desk's stale limit is not sent without the agent's check. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The terminal already shows the quote. The build packages it and blocks a stale send. It does not add a second price source.
Any edit voids the pack. No seller score is stored.
unknowns: What age the desk treats as a stale quote.
Whether issuer filings are already in {DOCS}.
research_questions: What share of quote requests is for a stale name?
How often is a quote followed by a request for advice?

already_counted.description: The agent still checks a stale quote and approves the pack.

incremental.description: Keep the stale-quote limit and the issuer-filing link current.

approvals.approved_version: quote-pack v1: instrument, price, as-of, issuer-filing-id
quote-pack v1: instrument, price, as-of, issuer-filing-id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the terminal is often stale and the issuer note is missing, the agent still hunts both and the pack saves only the fresh quotes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show contracts that are unsigned or late.
Supervise support staff on the day's open work.
Ensure proper execution of the open contracts.

tasks.design: A {PROJECT} list shows contracts in {CLM} that are unsigned or past the execution date. The agent supervises the support staff in person and decides what happens next. The list is contract status. It is not a score of the staff, and it does not assign work by behaviour.
tasks.previous_blocker: Late contracts lived in a pile, so supervision started from whoever spoke up.
tasks.enabler_now: Unsigned and late are dates on a contract record. Ranking staff is not part of this task.
tasks.still_hard: How to coach a person, and whether a counterparty will still sign, stays with the agent.
tasks.human_edge: The agent supervises the people and decides the next step on a contract. A date on a list does not do either.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays the day. The change is that a late contract is visible without scoring anyone.

reach.task: see which offer is unsigned without ranking the agent
reach.learn: which status is a date and which conversation must stay human

evidence.claim: A list of unsigned contracts is a record sorted by date. Supervision of people stays manual.
The job digest says scoring sellers needs works-council consent. This list stores no score and does not rank staff. Assigning work by behaviour is out of scope.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is supervision and execution of contracts already in hand. Negotiating a new price is another task.

Fields: contract id, counterparty, status, due date, owner. Status comes from {CLM}. The agent types the instruction. No performance score is stored. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The contract record already has a status. The build lists the open ones. It does not add a staff-monitoring tool.
The execution decision is signed by the agent. Any edit voids it. Works-council consent for scoring is not sought because no score is created.
unknowns: Whether support staff already work from the contract system.
Which execution steps the agent may take without a second signature.
research_questions: What share of contracts is late on a normal week?
How much of the hour is the staff conversation rather than the list?

already_counted.description: The agent still supervises the staff.

incremental.description: Keep the late-contract rule and the status values current.

approvals.approved_version: execution v1: contract-id, status, next-step, decision-date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If supervision is still the conversation, the list only saves the hunt for the late file.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the order already written on the ticket.
Relay buy or sell orders to the exchange.
Send that approved order to the venue.
Handle a venue reject on the same order.

tasks.design: The order already on the ticket is shown in the {CRM}. The agent relays it to the exchange or the trading department and approves that version. The send to the venue uses only that version. A reject comes back to the agent. There is no silent retry.
tasks.previous_blocker: The relay was a second typing of the ticket, so the venue could see a size the client had not agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: The approved ticket is already a version. Relaying that version, and only that version, is integration.
tasks.still_hard: A reject, a closed market, or a size the desk will not take still needs the agent on the phone.
tasks.human_edge: The agent owns the relay and the reject. A feed must not change the size after approval.
tasks.altitude: The agent still relays and still handles rejects. The second typing of a clean ticket drops out.

reach.task: send a booking that matches the approved itinerary
reach.learn: which change voids the approval and stops the send

evidence.claim: Sending an already approved order is integration. The relay decision and the reject stay with the agent.
The job digest says order-related calls and messages are kept for five years, and up to seven, even when no trade follows.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task relays an order that already exists. Agreeing the price is another task.

Fields: instrument, side, size, limit, client id, ticket version. The version comes from the approved ticket. A reject does not create a new send. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The venue screen already accepts an order. The build sends the approved version only. It does not add a second order-entry app.
Any edit voids the version and stops the send. The reject is handled by the agent. No seller score is stored.
unknowns: Whether the trading department wants a phone relay as well as a message.
Which rejects the venue returns as a code.
research_questions: What share of relays is still a phone call?
How often does a reject change the size?

already_counted.description: The agent still relays the order.
The agent still handles a reject.

incremental.description: Keep the venue field map current.

approvals.approved_version: relay-order v1: instrument, side, size, limit, ticket-version
relay-order v1: instrument, side, size, limit, ticket-version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If most relays are still a phone call and rejects often change the size, the saving is the pre-filled ticket, not the call.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The agent keeps the staff conversation and the decision to relay an order. Reports and quote packs are prepared and signed.
reach: Travel agent: send a price only after it matches the rate card, and learn which stale figure must be withheld.
Real estate broker: chase an unsigned contract without scoring the person who chased it.
skills_to_grow: Read a financial report back to the balances before it is sent.
Refuse a relay when the ticket version is not the one that was approved.
role.ambitious_version: A quote pack and a finance report go out the same day for smaller accounts, and an unsigned contract is visible without scoring the staff.

job.title: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
